subject.title: fix(agents): retry same profile before timeout auth rotation

question: Should ordinary assistant request timeouts spend one same-profile retry before the existing auth-profile rotation and configured model-fallback policy for all existing installations?
rationale: This is a deliberate default policy change: it trades faster failover for preserving the current auth profile after a transient timeout, and source/tests alone cannot establish the intended operational balance.

options.title: Adopt bounded same-profile retry
options.body: Accept one ordinary-timeout retry before rotation, contingent on exact-head runtime and transcript proof.

options.title: Keep immediate rotation
options.body: Retain current failover timing and close this PR if timeout should continue to consume the rotation path immediately.

options.title: Narrow the policy
options.body: Restrict the retry to a maintainer-defined timeout class if broad ordinary-timeout handling is too risky.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded same-profile retry
recommendation.body: Accept one ordinary-timeout retry before rotation, contingent on exact-head runtime and transcript proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the adjacent timeout and auth-profile cooldown semantics most affected by this choice.
